title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Oktyabrsky Concert Hall, Saint Petersburg | 2011
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Oktyabrsky Concert Hall (BKZ) in Saint Petersburg, Russia, on 7 June 2011.

It was the third show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between June and November 2011.

Starr had previously performed at the BKZ Oktyabrsky on 26 August 1998.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
